anchoredLines.line: 🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 8,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Kenji Reyes and Victor Ford and Theo Dubois and Sofia Lund and Mei Haddad and Marcus Fischer will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Omar Weiss and Lena Hassan will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Deshawn Nguyen and Ben Weber will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
⚔ THE HERALD! You're on your own.
🌅 THE HERALD FALLS. The realm exhales. That was the herald. The sky is still getting bigger.
